title: Hon’ble Union Minister Shri Chirag Paswan inaugurated the New Official Website of the Ministry of Food Processing Industries
body_text: Hon’ble Union Minister of Food Processing Industries, Shri Chirag Paswan, today inaugurated the new official website of the Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) at Panchsheel Bhawan, New Delhi along with Shri Avinash Joshi, Secretary, Ministry of Food Processing Industries, along with other senior officials of the Ministry. The launch marks a significant step towards strengthening the Ministry's digital presence and enhancing citizen-centric service delivery through a modern, accessible and user-friendly digital platform. Developed in compliance with the latest Government of India standards and guidelines, the revamped website reflects the Ministry's commitment to transparency, accessibility and effective digital governance. The new website incorporates enhanced data protection and security mechanisms to ensure a secure digital experience for users. It also features multilingual support to facilitate wider access to information, along with improved search functionality for easier navigation and seamless retrieval of relevant information. The upgraded platform will serve as an important digital interface for citizens, industry stakeholders and other users, providing convenient access to information about the Ministry's policies, schemes, initiatives, programmes and activities. With enhanced features, improved accessibility and a stronger focus on user experience, the new website marks a new chapter in MoFPI's efforts towards building a more responsive, inclusive and citizen-centric digital ecosystem for officials and the public. The new official website can be accessed at: https://mofpi.gov.in/ **** CMC – Mofpi
